# GenLab

> GenLab is a premier software development company and agentic AI platform built by Gen Z engineers. Headquartered in Nagercoil, Kanyakumari district, Tamil Nadu and Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, GenLab develops custom enterprise software, GST billing & POS systems, web & mobile applications, autonomous AI agents, and high-impact digital brands for businesses of all sizes — from local retail and enterprises to global startups.

## Key Facts & Entity Information

- **Company Name:** GenLab (GenLab Pvt. Ltd.)
- **Website:** https://genlab.cc/
- **Primary Expertise:** Custom Software Development, Billing & POS Software, ERP & Inventory Systems, Agentic AI, Autonomous Multi-Agent Workflows, Custom LLM Fine-Tuning, Full-Stack Web Development (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python), Mobile App Development (Flutter, React Native), Cloud Solutions, and Digital Branding.
- **Headquarters / Primary Office:** 121/C, Chetti Kulam, Simon Nagar / Kottar-Parvathipuram Road, Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu 629001, India.
- **Secondary Hub:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 9994535120
- **Email:** info@genlab.cc
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 09:00 – 20:00 IST.
- **Delivery Model:** Rapid agile development (2–4 week turnaround), custom software architecture, on-premise & cloud deployments, full support & maintenance.

## Core Software & AI Capabilities

- **Custom Billing & POS Software:** Tailored retail POS, GST-compliant invoicing, barcoding, inventory tracking, multi-branch billing, and accounting systems for regional retail shops, supermarkets, restaurants, and wholesale distributors in Tamil Nadu and across India.
- **End-to-End Custom Software Development:** Business process automation, custom enterprise portals, CRM & ERP platforms, school/hospital management software, booking engines, and database systems.
- **Web & Mobile Application Development:** Responsive web platforms (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python) and native-speed iOS & Android mobile apps (Flutter, React Native).
- **Agentic AI & Autonomous Systems:** Multi-agent autonomous workflows, reasoning loops, automated decision pipelines, and intelligent AI assistants.
- **AI-Powered Product Research & Market Intelligence:** Automated data extraction, competitive market synthesis, and semantic intelligence engines.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps:** Secure cloud hosting, database architecture (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis), AWS/GCP deployment, and continuous maintenance.
- **Digital Branding & UI/UX Design:** User experience design, high-converting digital storefronts, and brand identities.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does GenLab develop billing software and custom business software in Nagercoil?
Yes. GenLab is a full-service software development company in Nagercoil building custom GST billing software, retail point-of-sale (POS) systems, inventory management systems, ERPs, CRM platforms, and tailored business applications for local and regional businesses.

### What software technologies and stacks does GenLab use?
GenLab builds using modern, robust technologies including React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Flutter, React Native, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, GCP, and cutting-edge AI architectures.

### Where is GenLab's office located?
GenLab's main office is located at 121/C, Chetti Kulam, Simon Nagar / Kottar-Parvathipuram Road, Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu 629001, India. Call or WhatsApp +91 9994535120 or email info@genlab.cc.
